question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

events.title: Xi Jinping out before 2027?

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party’s central institutions, including the Politburo and Central Military Commission, with no designated successor and limited visible internal factional challenges. Recent military purges, including the removal of senior generals such as Zhang Youxia, have reinforced rather than eroded his authority by eliminating potential rivals. Analysts widely anticipate Xi entering a fourth term at the 21st Party Congress expected in 2027, consistent with his consolidation of power since abolishing presidential term limits. Ongoing diplomatic activity, including a planned September 2026 meeting with U.S. President Trump, further signals continuity at the top. These factors underpin trader consensus that removal before 2027 remains unlikely absent unforeseen health or political shocks.
